item.title: No suspect identified in disappearance of Savannah Guthrie's mom
item.description: The disappearance of "Today" show co-host Savannah Guthrie's mother, Nancy Guthrie, is being investigated as a crime.

item.title: Family friend calls Nancy Guthrie's disappearance "heart-wrenching"
item.description: "Nancy and Savannah have both contributed so much to the Tucson community," Sally Shamrell, the Guthries' family friend of over 30 years, told CBS News.

item.title: 1/31: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Bomb cyclone causing blizzard-like conditions hits Eastern Seaboard; Historic recording by “Sly and the Family Stone” released after gathering dust: “Sheer magic”

item.title: Democrats lay out demands for DHS funding, urging GOP to "get serious"
item.description: Democratic leaders outlined their demands for funding the Department of Homeland Security beyond next week.

item.title: ICE can't make warrantless arrests in Oregon unless there's risk of escape, judge rules
item.description: A judge says U.S. immigration agents in Oregon must stop arresting people without warrants unless they are likely to escape.

item.title: LaMonte McLemore, singer and founding member of The 5th Dimension, dies at 90
item.description: The 5th Dimension had broad crossover success and won six Grammy Awards, including record of the year twice.

item.title: Sixth person arrested in connection with shooting of judge, wife in Indiana
item.description: Police have accused members of a motorcycle club​ and a street gang of targeting the judge.

item.title: Trump to give Medal of Honor to pilot who secretly faced off with Soviet jets
item.description: President Trump is awarding the Medal of Honor to a pilot whose faceoff with Soviet fighter jets remained secret for a half-century and a soldier who died in Afghanistan while shielding somebody from a suicide bomber.

item.title: 2/4: CBS Evening News
item.description: Day four of search for Nancy Guthrie, still no suspect; Department of Homeland Security to pull about 700 agents from Minneapolis.

item.title: Fire at Lehigh Valley Hospital in Dickson City prompts dozens of evacuations
item.description: Crews are battling a large fire at Lehigh Valley Hospital in Dickson City, Pennsylvania, Wednesday night.
